title: The maths of card games
examples: How many cards are in a standard deck?
What are the four suits in a deck?
If I draw a card, what is the chance it is an ace?

explain.say: A standard deck of playing cards has a total of fifty two cards.
These fifty two cards are divided into four different suits.

draw.text: Four suits: Hearts, Diamonds, Clubs, Spades

explain.say: Each of the four suits contains ten cards from ace to king.
The ace is a special card that appears once in every single suit.
To find the probability of drawing an ace, we use a simple fraction.
If you draw one card, the chance of it being an ace is four over fifty two.

faq.q: How many cards are in a full deck?
faq.a: A standard deck has fifty two cards in total. You might also ask how many cards are in a deck, or what is the total number of cards.
asks: What is the size of the deck?
Does a deck have fifty two cards?

faq.a: The four suits are hearts, diamonds, clubs, and spades. These suits help organize the cards in the deck. You could also ask what suits are in a deck, or name the card suits.
asks: What are the types of suits?
Can you list the four suits?

faq.a: There is one ace in each of the four suits. This means there are four aces altogether. You might ask how many aces exist, or count the aces.
asks: How many times does the ace appear?

faq.q: What is the probability of drawing an ace?
faq.a: The probability is four divided by fifty two. This simplifies to one over thirteen. You could also ask what is the chance of an ace, or calculate P(Ace).
asks: What is the chance of drawing an ace?
What is the probability of getting an ace?

faq.q: Does the probability change if I draw a card?
faq.a: Yes, the probability changes because the total number of cards decreases. This is called dependent probability. You could ask if the pool of cards changes, or does the first draw affect the second?
asks: Does drawing one card change the odds?

facts: A standard deck contains fifty two cards.
The four suits are hearts, diamonds, clubs, and spades.
Each suit has ten ranks, from ace to king.
There are exactly four aces in the entire deck.

quiz.say: A deck has 52 cards. If you draw one card, what is the probability of it being a heart?
quiz.why: There are 13 hearts out of 52 cards, which simplifies to one fourth.

quiz.say: If you draw two cards without replacement, what is the probability the first is an ace and the second is also an ace?
quiz.why: The first draw is four over fifty two, and the second is three over fifty one, multiplying them gives the correct answer.

wrong.0: This is wrong because it assumes the first card was put back into the deck.
wrong.1: This is wrong because it uses the simplified probability twice, ignoring the change in the deck.
wrong.2: This is wrong because the denominator for the second draw must decrease by one.

quiz.say: In a 52-card deck, how many cards are NOT spades?
quiz.why: You subtract the 13 spades from the total 52 cards to find the remaining cards.

wrong.1: This is wrong because it incorrectly performs division when subtraction is needed.
